notes.title: Watch the developer play Twisted Tower
notes.notes: Hey guys my name is Thomas Brush. I'm the creator of Twisted Tower! Join me as I play Twisted Tower!

notes.title: The Twisted Tower demo is officially live and ready to play!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sjgq8mKLl90

Hey everyone, my name is Thomas Brush if you don't know me. I'm the creator of Twisted Tower. 

I'm super thrilled to announce that the Twisted Tower demo is ready to play! I've been working on this game for three years, alongside a super talented crew of 3D artists (shoutout to Felipe!), developers, and my publisher 3D Realms. 

You can play the free demo here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2506090/Twisted_Tower_Demo/

This project was not without it's difficulties. It started as a completely different concept, and after disposing of pretty much every asset in the game 2 or 3 times over, we finally figured out what this game is...

It's super inspired by BioShock (shoutout to Ken Levine!), but also my favorite place on earth, Disney World, and one of my favorite movies ever, Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory.

I hope you love it as much as I loved creating it. 

All the best,
Thomas
